claude_proposed_widenings.name: traversal_window
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Spike Growth deals damage when a creature moves into or within the area — one event per foot (or per 5-foot unit) of movement traversed. No existing window atom covers this: on_hit_window requires an attack roll, post_action_window fires after an action, turn_start/end_window fire at turn boundaries. A new window atom is needed for 'creature enters or moves through the attachment area' triggers.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When a creature moves into or within the area, it takes 2d4 Piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: difficult_terrain
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Spike Growth makes the area Difficult Terrain — movement into affected squares costs 2 feet per foot traveled. v4 has modify_speed (changes creature speed stat) and block_travel (prevents movement entirely); neither is honest for Difficult Terrain, which doubles movement cost. A terrain-modification effect atom is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The area becomes Difficult Terrain for the duration.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: traversal_damage (new OngoingOperation variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing OngoingOperation union has roll_modifier (adds dice to existing rolls) and damage_on_hit (damage when caster lands an attack on a creature in scope). Spike Growth needs a third variant: damage that fires per unit of distance a creature travels through the area. This is structurally distinct from both existing variants — it requires the traversal_window atom and a per-5-feet damage expression not representable in any current DiceAmount shape.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: it takes 2d4 Piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels

claude_proposed_widenings.name: distance_proportional DiceAmount
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Existing DiceAmount shapes are fixed, threshold_tiers (by level axis), and linear_per_level. Spike Growth's damage is proportional to distance traversed per activation — '2d4 per 5 feet'. This is not level-scaled; it fires N times based on how many 5-foot increments the creature moves. A distance_proportional DiceAmount variant (or a traversal_damage operation that encodes the per-increment amount directly) is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: it takes 2d4 Piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels
